'''June 2001 Spokane tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG casual held in Spokane, Washington on 1 June 2001. It is known from Evan Walker's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2400">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-01-spokane-wa-6-1-01d2400/ spokane-wa-6-1-01], DeckTech (Evan "EvO" Walker, 1 June 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-01-spokane-wa-6-1-01d2400/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 1 June 2001
* '''Site:''' Spokane, Washington
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Players:''' 8
